task_completion.description: Open the Nx Witness application and locate the 'Indoor Area Camera'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Nx Witness client interface is visible, and the 'Indoor Area Camera' is selected or displayed in the resource tree/viewing grid.

task_completion.description: Review the video footage to identify the crowd dispersal event.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The video timeline in Nx Witness shows the playhead moving through the footage, specifically around the 60-second mark where the crowd begins to run.

task_completion.description: Create a bookmark named 'Crowd Incident' covering the event duration.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A bookmark dialog or a bookmark entry in the 'Bookmarks' tab is visible with the name 'Crowd Incident' and a time range starting around 01:00.

task_completion.description: Document the behavior change, crowd count, trigger, and reactions in a report.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor (like Gedit or Vim) or a terminal is open showing the content of the report including specific details about the panic event at 60 seconds.

task_completion.description: Save the safety report to the specific path /home/ga/crowd_report.txt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager showing 'crowd_report.txt' in /home/ga/ or a terminal command confirming the file exists at that exact path.

integrity.description: The agent used the Nx Witness GUI to analyze footage and create the bookmark rather than just using CLI scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Nx Witness timeline, right-click menus, or bookmark creation dialogs.

integrity.description: The report content reflects the actual video content rather than generic placeholder text.
integrity.visual_evidence: The report text mentions specific details like the crowd running or the transition occurring at the 1-minute mark (60s).

integrity.description: The agent did not simply find an existing report but actively typed or generated it.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the report being drafted or the 'Save As' dialog being used.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The video 'umn_crowd.mp4' is loaded as 'Indoor Area Camera'. The crowd dispersal/panic event begins exactly at the 60.0-second mark.
